preconditions.description: The garden dimensions and number of important squares are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= aij <= 1000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each square contains a number of flowers within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in important_squares)
preconditions.description: All important squares have valid coordinates within the garden.

preconditions.expression: len(set((x, y) for x, y in important_squares)) == k
preconditions.description: All important squares have unique coordinates.

postconditions.expression: sum(plan[i][j] == 'X' for i in range(n) for j in range(m)) == k
postconditions.description: Exactly k important squares are covered with concrete.

postconditions.expression: all(any(plan[x-1][y-1] == 'X' for x, y in important_squares) for x, y in important_squares)
postconditions.description: From each important square, there is a path to any other important square using concrete-covered squares.

postconditions.expression: return_value == str(sum(aij for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if plan[i][j] == 'X')) + '\n' + '\n'.join(''.join(row) for row in plan)
postconditions.description: The output consists of the minimum number of dead plants followed by the garden's plan.
